notes: No high findings for TASK-0008 or TASK-0009. The `stack-smoke` job runs only when `github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'`, which the `on:` already declares. The diff only appends at the end of ci.yml, so the five required checks are unchanged. The digest at ci.yml:435 matches ci.yml:180 and `DB_IMAGE` in tools/detran-stack.sh:17. The job uses `PACKAGES_READ_TOKEN` like `foundation`. `stack:stop` runs under `if: always()`. The config check reads `bash tools/detran-stack.sh config`, which avoids the pnpm banner.

The runbook matches the code: the refused overrides (`DB_HOST`/`DB_PORT`/`DB_USER`/`DETRAN_DB_IMAGE`/`DETRAN_BACKEND_PORT`, detran-stack.sh:123), the 120 s timeout, ports 3000/3001/3999/4200-4204, PEC `not_built_r0031`, `db-init` without reset (line 65) and the `smoke-report[-<sufixo>]` names (smoke.mjs:93). The external-integrations table matches OD-R17-001, 002 and 004. `.env.example` has no real credential; the only `PASSWORD` value is the local disposable Postgres default.

Low: `.env.example` sets `DETRAN_STACK_STATE_DIR=/tmp/detran-stack`, but the script's default uses `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}` and the runbook says not to fix `state_dir` in documentation. Consider leaving it empty or commenting it out. The empty `DETRAN_LOCAL_*` and `SENATRAN_MOCK_*` lines are harmless only if they are not exported as empty strings; the runbook could say this.
